courses.note: Elective: the AS requires no operating systems or security course. CS 160A is the CS department's most frequently offered systems course (several sections in Fall 2025 and Fall 2026; CS 270 is C3). The newest public syllabus found is a Fall 2020 section, which predates ChatGPT. Other public CS 160A syllabi: a Spring 2017 section (fog.ccsf.edu/~gboyd/cs160a/Syllabus-Day.pdf). The Fall 2026 sections point to instructor pages that carry no syllabus text (hills.ccsf.edu/~cconner, daveteaches.com/ccsf).

notes: CCSF is a community college with no bachelor's in CS, so the nearest equivalent, the AS in Computer Science (effective Fall 2022), is used as the program. Its required courses are CS 110B or 111B, CS 110C or 111C, CS 270, and math. CS 110A (Intro to Programming and CS) is recommended preparation but is not a required course in the program report, so CS 110B is taken as CS1. Syllabi come from individual instructors' pages, so they represent one section each.
